attunement.limit.label: Attunement capacity
attunement.limit.formula: maximum of the ruleset limit and unlocked class capacities

bodyPlacement.label: Body placement
bodyPlacement.formula: Authored display organization of equipped inventory instances. Placement grants no bonuses or extra equipment slots and does not limit the number of worn accessories. Armor, shield and attunement rules are evaluated separately.

carrying.label: Carrying
carrying.formula: Weight × quantity of equipped and carried items, plus coins when counted, against the Strength score × the ruleset's capacity per point. Items without a known weight are left out.

classes.0.level.label: classes.0.level
classes.0.level.formula: Result of the selected rule and its applicable progression row.

concentration.label: Concentration
concentration.formula: Authored play state. Casting a Concentration spell replaces it; damage records the save DC; keeping or ending it is an explicit command.

concentrationSaveBonus.label: concentrationSaveBonus
concentrationSaveBonus.formula: Result of the selected rule and its applicable progression row.

conditionEffects.d20Adjustment.label: D20 roll adjustment
conditionEffects.d20Adjustment.formula: Sum of source-declared penalties for active condition levels. Apply once to each D20 Test, including Initiative. This adjustment is not included in printed bonuses or spell save DCs.

conditions.label: Conditions
conditions.formula: Authored conditions are preserved until explicitly changed. Movement restrictions apply to displayed speeds. Apply the separate D20 adjustment to rolls; ability modifiers, printed roll bonuses and spell save DCs remain unchanged. Situational effects and ending conditions require adjudication.

derived.armorClass.label: Armor Class
derived.armorClass.formula: highest eligible AC formula + shield + applicable bonuses

derived.maxHp.label: Maximum HP
derived.maxHp.formula: sum of each level's max(minimum gain, hit die result + Constitution modifier) + per-level grants + fixed grants

derived.speed.label: Speed
derived.speed.formula: species movement + applicable grants and active effects Apply source-declared condition restrictions after other speed effects; zero Speed takes precedence.
